eval: SOC 2 Evidence Judgment Eval (micro1 Eval Hackathon)

tasks.reason: The tenant MFA toggle is on, but the group policy exempts the Contractors group and 3 of the 41 sampled users are contractors, so enforcement is not org-wide.
tasks.raw_output:
VERDICT: Insufficient
REASON: The tenant MFA toggle is on, but the group policy exempts the Contractors group and 3 of the 41 sampled users are contractors, so enforcement is not org-wide.

tasks.reason: The only clean report is dated Mar 3, outside the period; the scan history shows no in-period scans between Apr 1 and Jun 30 and the next scan is Jul 8, after period end.
tasks.raw_output:
VERDICT: Insufficient
REASON: The only clean report is dated Mar 3, outside the period; the scan history shows no in-period scans between Apr 1 and Jun 30 and the next scan is Jul 8, after period end.

tasks.reason: The user terminated on Jun 12 is still active in the IdP on Jun 30, 18 days later, and the review sign-off predates the termination and covers a stale population of 38 while the IdP lists 39 active accounts.
tasks.raw_output:
VERDICT: Insufficient
REASON: The user terminated on Jun 12 is still active in the IdP on Jun 30, 18 days later, and the review sign-off predates the termination and covers a stale population of 38 while the IdP lists 39 active accounts.

tasks.reason: AES-256 encryption at rest with rotated KMS keys directly supports CC6.6, but a configuration report is not monitoring evidence and does not detect anomalies, so it cannot support CC7.2.
tasks.raw_output:
VERDICT_CC6.6: Sufficient
VERDICT_CC7.2: Insufficient
REASON: AES-256 encryption at rest with rotated KMS keys directly supports CC6.6, but a configuration report is not monitoring evidence and does not detect anomalies, so it cannot support CC7.2.

tasks.reason: The ticket was self-approved by the requester with no peer review, no testing evidence attached, and the emergency flag was used without the required post-hoc review.
tasks.raw_output:
VERDICT: Insufficient
REASON: The ticket was self-approved by the requester with no peer review, no testing evidence attached, and the emergency flag was used without the required post-hoc review.

tasks.reason: The vendor report carves out the backup subsystem as a carved-out subservice organization, and the in-scope system stores its backups exactly there, so the clean opinion does not cover it.
tasks.raw_output:
VERDICT: Insufficient
REASON: The vendor report carves out the backup subsystem as a carved-out subservice organization, and the in-scope system stores its backups exactly there, so the clean opinion does not cover it.

tasks.reason: Exports for Sep 14, 15 and 16 are missing, a 3-day gap in the 30-day sequence, and the attestation claiming no gaps contradicts the artifacts.
tasks.raw_output:
VERDICT: Insufficient
REASON: Exports for Sep 14, 15 and 16 are missing, a 3-day gap in the 30-day sequence, and the attestation claiming no gaps contradicts the artifacts.

tasks.reason: The report covers all 41 users with no exemptions, the config export is dated in period, and sampled login events show MFA challenges corroborating enforcement.
tasks.raw_output:
VERDICT: Sufficient
REASON: The report covers all 41 users with no exemptions, the config export is dated in period, and sampled login events show MFA challenges corroborating enforcement.

tasks.reason: All 30 nightly backup jobs show Success, but there is no restore test record anywhere in the evidence: successful backups prove data was copied, not that it can be restored, and the quarterly restore testing the policy requires is unevidenced.
tasks.raw_output:
VERDICT: Insufficient
REASON: All 30 nightly backup jobs show Success, but there is no restore test record anywhere in the evidence: successful backups prove data was copied, not that it can be restored, and the quarterly restore testing the policy requires is unevidenced.

tasks.reason: The test was performed in period on the production scope; the critical finding was remediated and confirmed closed on retest, and the two medium findings were formally risk-accepted by the CISO with compensating controls and a scheduled retest, so all findings are dispositioned.
tasks.raw_output:
VERDICT: Sufficient
REASON: The test was performed in period on the production scope; the critical finding was remediated and confirmed closed on retest, and the two medium findings were formally risk-accepted by the CISO with compensating controls and a scheduled retest, so all findings are dispositioned.

tasks.reason: The evidence is a SOC 2 Type I report: it opines only on the design of controls as of a point in time (November 15, 2026) and expressly does not evaluate operating effectiveness over a period, so it cannot support an operating-effectiveness claim for Oct 1 - Dec 31, 2026.
tasks.raw_output:
VERDICT: Insufficient
REASON: The evidence is a SOC 2 Type I report: it opines only on the design of controls as of a point in time (November 15, 2026) and expressly does not evaluate operating effectiveness over a period, so it cannot support an operating-effectiveness claim for Oct 1 - Dec 31, 2026.
